newsitem.title: UK: Vertex claims progress with HIV treatment.
newsitem.headline: Vertex claims progress with HIV treatment.

text.p: U.S.-based Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc on Sunday claimed fresh progress in the treatment of the HIV virus that causes AIDS with a therapy using a combination of drugs.

After trials on seven patients of a new combination therapy being carried out by Glaxo Wellcome Plc of Britain, Vertex, which designed the therapy, said two patients had withdrawn due to side-effects but the other five had virus levels reduced to virtually undetectable.

"While it would be extremely premature to draw any conclusions based on such early results in such a small number of patients, we are encouraged by these initial reports," Glaxo director of worldwide clinincal research Richard Kent said.
Results of the four-week trial were presented at a conference in Washington on Sunday and involved a combination of two antiretroviral agents, codenamed 1592U89 and 141W94/VX-478, Vertex said.
